files.mirrors: X1 spec §6 060100 (X1-01: reference data, positions, position manning), 060200 (X1-02: vessel crew list, movements, transfers table) and 060300 (X1-03: personal details, languages, employment terms, next-of-kin phone columns, profile RPCs)

functions.crew_vessel_cap: RLS predicate and X1 definer gate (X1 spec §3, 20261124060100): text-first boolean the policies and every X1 definer call; the client gates with useCan() on the same capability keys
functions.crew_cap_vessel_ids: RLS helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060100): the caller's vessels holding a capability key, computed once per statement in the X1 read policies; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_caller_is_external: RLS and RPC helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060200): caller-only boolean the crew_movements / crew_transfers policies and the crew RPCs use to refuse external viewers; the browser does not call it
functions.crew_profile_visible: RLS and X1 definer helper (X1 spec §3, 20261124060300): one-argument boolean "the caller may see this person" the profile definers gate with; the page asks crew_profile_resolve / crew_profile_summary, which answer P0002 for an invisible person
functions.crew_visible_profile_ids: RLS helper (D-229, X1 spec §3, 20261124060300): the profiles the caller may see, computed once per statement in the crew_personal_details / crew_languages read policies; the browser does not call it
